summary.headline: Against Astrology and Star Worship
summary.text: Theological critique of genethlialogies and apotelesmatic astrology, arguing that earthquakes, eclipses, deaths, wars, shipwrecks, and other events must not be attributed to the elements or stars as gods. Citing Isaiah’s taunt against Babylonian astrologers, the text affirms God’s power over stars, rulers, armies, life, death, and all things.
